# Al Garhoud Mid-Rise Building

> This mid-rise building stands in Al Garhoud, an established Dubai district beside Dubai International Airport and the Creek. It is arranged as two basement levels, a ground floor with a mezzanine, thirteen upper storeys and a roof level, giving about fifteen occupied floors above ground with parking below. Al Garhoud is a relatively low-density area of villas, hotels and apartment blocks close to the airport and the Garhoud Bridge.

## Project Overview

- Category: Residential / Commercial
- Location: Al Garhoud, Dubai, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

This mid-rise building in Al Garhoud, close to Dubai International Airport, is arranged in a 2B+G+M+13+H configuration of two basements, a ground floor, a mezzanine and 13 upper floors with an additional top level. It was delivered with Transemirates as main contractor. MENASCO executed the MEP works for the building, providing the mechanical, electrical and plumbing services across all levels.
